localShare.title: Local sharing for smartphones
localShare.description: Temporarily share this Web UI with one smartphone over a physical wired LAN or a verified private WPA2-AES/WPA3 Wi-Fi connection.
localShare.off: Off. No listener is exposed to the local network.
localShare.qrCopyHint: Akses langsung dari kode QR mungkin gagal. Salin URL lalu tempelkan ke bilah alamat browser.
localShare.warning: This QR code opens a local HTTPS URL. Enchan reuses one direct self-signed certificate for this Windows user and LAN IP. Safari may show a certificate warning on first use. Enchan does not switch this connection to HTTP. Sharing stops automatically if the network changes, the PC sleeps, or the smartphone becomes inactive.
localShare.stopReason.network_changed_or: Sharing stopped because the network changed or could no longer be verified.
localShare.stopReason.network_changed: Sharing stopped because the network changed.
localShare.stopReason.network_security_u: Sharing stopped because network security could no longer be verified.
localShare.stopReason.computer_sleep_or_: Sharing stopped because the PC slept or paused.
localShare.stopReason.remote_device_inac: Sharing stopped because the smartphone became inactive.
localShare.stopReason.webui_shutdown: Sharing stopped because the Web UI closed.
